scenes.narration: Clear communication is key to a successful Ministry. We know life happens, and sometimes you need to swap your serving date. With My Church Resource, it's easy.
To give away a date, open Calendar.
Tap the date you are playing.
Then tap Swap on your service card.
Ask my position group posts an open request any matching player can take. Request from specific person is a direct trade with one person.
For an open request, add a short note if you want, then tap Send Request. Weekend dates move as a pair, Saturday and Sunday together.
For a direct trade, first pick the weekend you can play. Then choose who you want to swap with, and send the request.
Answers live under your initials, then Swaps.
Incoming is what other people asked you. Accept or Decline there.
My Requests is what you sent. A swap is done when the other person accepts.

Make sure that swap requests are no later than one week in advance of the Serving Date. If you have a last minute emergency, always reach out to your Ministry Lead. When a swap request goes unanswered, and the setlist goes out for that date, your leader will be notified that there is a gap to be filled.
